providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Vast.ai and RunPod are operational. Akash is experimental: the public API exposes live GPU capacity but no fixed price, so Akash records have price_available=false and pricing_model=bid.

maxItemsPerProvider.title: Maximum offers per provider
maxItemsPerProvider.description: Upper bound on normalized offers emitted per provider. A run that hits this cap is marked incomplete and cannot emit disappearance events for that provider.

gpuModels.title: GPU models
gpuModels.description: Optional normalized model allowlist, for example H100, A100, RTX 4090. Empty means all models.

minGpuMemoryGb.title: Minimum VRAM (GB)
minGpuMemoryGb.description: Drop offers whose reported VRAM is below this value. Unknown VRAM is retained.

maxPricePerGpuHourUsd.title: Maximum USD per GPU-hour
maxPricePerGpuHourUsd.description: Optional budget ceiling. When set, unpriced capacity records are excluded because they cannot be compared to a budget.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Optional case-insensitive substring allowlist matched against region or country, for example Oregon, us-east, Netherlands.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Optional ISO-3166 alpha-2 country allowlist, for example US, DE, NL.

includeRawPayload.title: Include raw provider payload
includeRawPayload.description: Include the source record for provenance. Disable to reduce dataset size.

detectChanges.title: Detect changes across runs
detectChanges.description: Compare this run with persistent Actor state and emit new, updated, and disappeared events.

emitBaselineEvents.title: Emit events on first run
emitBaselineEvents.description: When false, the first successful collection establishes a baseline without flooding the events dataset with every offer as new.

priceChangeThresholdPercent.title: Price change threshold (%)
priceChangeThresholdPercent.description: Minimum absolute price change required to emit an updated event. Capacity changes are always emitted. Set 0 to emit every price change.

stateRetentionDays.title: State retention (days)
stateRetentionDays.description: Remove offers unseen for this many days from persistent comparison state.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Key-value store key holding cross-run state. Use a different key only when running an intentionally separate collection.

pushToRelay.title: Push to Relay / Tiger Data
pushToRelay.description: After collection, POST offers and events to the Relay admin API. Requires RELAY_INGEST_TOKEN and relayIngestUrl (or RELAY_INGEST_URL).

relayIngestUrl.title: Relay API URL
relayIngestUrl.description: Base URL of the deployed Relay Market Intelligence API, for example https://market.example.com. Required when pushToRelay is enabled.
